items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: And Louis was Bottom and I was TaTanya... From that show came "Darn That Dream"

ctx.x: At the Center Theater. And Louis was Bottom and I was TaTanya, queen of the fairies). From that show came "Darn That Dream" which I never recorded at that time. And the other things that I did in it were -- they had added some lyrics to some of the folk things that I had done to fit in with the show -- fit in with the theme of Midsummer Night's Dream.
But we were quite busy during those years, because I think --
